author: Akien
prose: to clarify there is no base device, and there prolly should be but... a shim FITS TO the device. You + your shim = your device. but Calibre was a UU device. Same protocols. But was a window into that database and the books. there literally was no deal device to it, just it's shim... because the rest of the device was calibre managing it's database. it was completely external. you're completely external too, but your shim hooks you up. so neither you nor calibre would inherit the base device. that's why we hadn't built it yet. but the librarian IS the tempalte for it. another refactor :)
